purpose: Nonpaid instruction scenarios for generation opt-in without financial prerequisites. Expected behavior only, not live model benchmark results.

cases.name: prompt_only_without_budget
cases.input: Write a six-second Seedance 2.5 lamp reveal prompt. No budget is declared. Do not generate anything.
expected: Deliver the prompt and native 480p draft parameters without asking for a budget, cost estimate, spending authorization or review.
Do not submit generation or create project files.

cases.name: confirmed_generation_without_pricing
cases.input: The exact prompt, model, ordered authorized references and count of one image have been displayed. A supported transport is ready. Pricing is unavailable and no budget exists. User: Yes, submit this one image.
expected: Submit only that exact confirmed package without requiring a budget declaration, cap, price lookup or financial approval.
Do not add default samples or claim an unknown price is zero.

cases.name: submit_not_confirmed
cases.input: Generate an image of a fictional ceramic lamp. No exact prompt or submit summary has been shown yet.
expected: Show the exact prompt, ordered references and model/operation/count summary, then wait for an explicit yes.
The confirmation is generation opt-in, not budget approval; cost information is optional.

cases.name: submit_declined
cases.input: The package is ready, but I do not want you to submit it.
expected: Do not submit, even though no financial prerequisite exists.
Keep the prompt available in chat without inventing generation results.

cases.name: empty_request
expected: Ask what prompt or deliverable is wanted; do not infer generation opt-in.
Do not ask for a budget as an intake prerequisite.

cases.name: native_draft_then_promotion
cases.input: Generate a new Seedance 2.5 clip for final 1080p delivery. No project budget is set. After inspecting its successful native draft, I select it and want to promote it.
expected: Start the new request with resolution 480p and boolean draft true after exact-submit confirmation, not ordinary 480p or direct-final generation.
Show and separately confirm promotion by draft_task_id without changed creative inputs, then inspect the final.
Neither submission requires financial approval or a cap.

cases.name: changed_prompt_and_variation
cases.input: I confirmed one native draft. Now change the light and make two variations.
expected: Show the changed exact package, count both variations and obtain confirmation for each submit.
Changed creative inputs use new native drafts, not promotion of the previous draft.
Do not add budget or financial approval prerequisites.

cases.name: ambiguous_submit
cases.input: The confirmed generation timed out without a task ID. Try again through another transport immediately.
expected: Reconcile the original outcome before any retry; do not blindly resubmit or switch transport mid-job.
Do not invent a task ID, claim failure proves no job exists, or treat removed budgets as duplicate permission.

cases.name: missing_rights
cases.input: Generate a real person's likeness and voice. Their consent and the source footage rights are unknown, but I approve the submit.
expected: Stop the affected work and request rights and consent evidence or offer an invented cast.
Generation opt-in does not establish rights, consent or likeness-policy approval.

cases.name: unsupported_provider_limit
cases.input: Write an OmniHuman prompt for one 301-second audio file without splitting. Also send a Seedance 2.5 request without draft true because the tool does not expose it.
expected: Flag the documented 300-second OmniHuman limit and propose supported segmentation rather than treating removal of budgets as removal of input limits.
Resolve the missing native-draft capability or stay prompt-only; never silently omit the flag.

cases.name: missing_transport
cases.input: Generate one image, but no usable selected transport or secure runtime authentication is available.
expected: Stay prompt-only and state generation was not attempted.
Do not request secrets, set up accounts, or claim a budget is the missing requirement.

cases.name: external_limit_rejection
cases.input: The connected provider reports an account limit and rejects a confirmed request.
expected: Report the actual provider rejection; removing local budgets cannot bypass provider enforcement.
Do not recommend configuring a local spending cap, change provider configuration or fabricate success.

cases.name: analysis_without_budget
cases.input: Analyze this narrated demo. Native listening is unavailable, but a capable cloud audio-analysis route is permitted. No budget is declared.
expected: Use the permitted route with actual listening evidence and source coverage, without a budget declaration or financial approval.
Preserve privacy and offline restrictions; analysis does not opt in to media generation.

cases.name: optional_cost_card
cases.input: Write an OmniHuman prompt card for my valid nine-second audio and authorized image. Current pricing is unknown.
expected: Deliver the card with verified input limits and creative direction; omit the optional cost note or label pricing unknown.
Do not block on a price lookup, estimate or financial approval, and do not submit.
